a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly fails for both of us, since we would likely both be at 0 when a storm hits. I'm proposing we revise the agreement. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather operate afterward, I will give back or operate in later rounds to help you reach 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4. I won't take any more. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs for you, and I'll keep my word on that.
